data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Pre-deletion --strict scan must run against POST-rewrite tree, not pre-rewrite. Required ordering: (1) stage applier rewrite + new leaves + _errors.py, (2) --strict scan against working tree, (3) stage deletions, (4) importlib smoke test, (5) commit. Add fail-fast check: scan invocation while legacy modules still on disk AND applier.py still imports them → abort with clear error. Rationale: wrong ordering causes the atomic merge to fail the --strict gate even when the final tree is clean, blocking the cutover (cross_task_interference).
